quotes.author: Dirk R.
quotes.text: Arrived this morning and to my great surprise, Joel was able to upgrade me to a very comfy pontoon boat. In short, we had a BLAST! Gorgeous day, very nice boat, very easy to drive and handle. The tour that Dave recommended was excellent and we found our way easily using the GPS. Highly recommend this place!
